content:
Hi everyone, I’m excited to share that TorchLean is now public.

TorchLean is a Lean 4 framework for neural networks: typed tensors, graph IRs, runnable training, autograd, Float32/IEEE-style semantics, CUDA/GPU support, verification, and certificate checking.

Since the earlier version, we have expanded the codebase quite a bit. It now includes examples and theories around neural operators/FNOs, diffusion, GPT-style text models, Mamba/state-space models, reinforcement learning, 3D vision certificates, Bug Zoo case studies, PyTorch interop, IBP/CROWN-style verification, and more.

Our goal is to make ML artifacts more precise: a model should not only run, but also have graph, gradient, numerical, and certificate objects that can be inspected and connected to formal claims!

Code: https://github.com/lean-dojo/TorchLean
Project page: https://leandojo.org/torchlean.html
LeanDocs: https://lean-dojo.github.io/TorchLean/docs/

Feedback and issues would be welcome!
